help.add_friends_p1: There are four ways you can add friends. You can access the friends page from the rightmost option in the bottom menu. Then you click the "Add" button.
help.add_friends_p2: Add your friend via their Friend Key.
help.add_friends_p3: Find your friend by searching for their name. Send them a friend request when you find them.
help.add_friends_p4: Send your friend your Friend Key. They can then add you as a friend.
help.add_friends_p6: Send your friend your invite link. You can copy the link on the "Add friends" page. When they follow the link you will become friends.
help.friend_gone_title: I can no longer see my friend
help.friend_gone_p1: Make sure you did not accidentally block each other. Both you and your partner should check the "Show blocked" option in the friends area. You can access the friends page from the rightmost option in the bottom menu.
help.stars_p1: Each board is scored with a star rating: 0-3
help.stars_p2: The better you did the more stars you get.
help.stars_p3: The stars are awarded based on your contract compared to the the par contract (the theoretical best contract with double dummy play).
help.stars_p4: If you beat the par contract by a lot (your score is way higher than what's required for 3 stars) you will see a rainbow effect on the stars. This usually happens if robots missed their game, or you doubled them in something!
help.robots_p2: Will bid their best suit, and based on their combined length and strength they will compete to a reasonable level.
help.robots_p3: Will bid like real people (in most cases) and use a 5-5-3-3 or "Best minor" system.
help.robots_p5: Robots might be changed with updates, which might result in slightly different experiences for different pairs on the same board.
help.robots_p6: You will be able to see other pairs' results even if they used other robots - which can look confusing.
help.robots_p7: Scoring will not use robots' bidding when simulating - thus their bidding cannot be used to place neither length nor honours when deciding on a contract.
help.robots_p8: The exception to this rule is the deal types where the robots are set to open or overcall something, such as pre-emptive practice. Then, the simulations will use their bids as input.
help.lia_p1: Lia is a bidding bot from IntoBridge. You can practice with Lia by selecting her as your partner in the dropdown.
help.lia_p2: Lia plays a SAYC 2/1 system and will explain both her own bids and her interpretation of your bids.
help.lia_p3: Please note that while Lia can bid quite well she is by no means an expert and will make mistakes. Please be understanding!
help.percentage_title: What is the % on each board?
help.percentage_p1: In addition to the star scoring (in which your result is compared to the theoretical best result on the board) you are also compared to what all other pairs did on the board.
help.percentage_p2: For this - a matchpoints system is used.
help.percentage_p4: 100% means you were alone to find the best contract and 50% means you got an average result.
help.scoring_p1: Each board is simulated many times to calculate the best contract based on double dummy* play.
help.scoring_p2: The contract you and your partner reach is then compared to the best contract in terms of expected value (e.g. 400 for 3NT making non vulnerable).
help.scoring_p3: The closer you are to the best contract the more stars you get (0-3).
help.scoring_p4: You can also see a % on each board, which is a matchpoint-based comparison to what everybody else who has played the same board did.
help.scoring_p5: Please note that robot bids will not be taken into account when doing simulations.
help.scoring_p6: *Double dummy means that the computer knows all hands and can play perfectly, however, we also make adjustments for human play.
help.why_subscribe_title: What do I get if I subscribe?
help.why_subscribe_p1: When you subscribe you unlock more features on Cuebids and can enhance your practice. The higher your level of subscription, the more features you unlock. Heart subscribers can access everything. Here are some things you can unlock:
help.why_subscribe_p2: Your support enables us to work more on Cuebids and improve it for everyone. Thank you for your support!
help.why_subscribe_store_button: Click here to go to our store
help.subscribe_store_button: Click here to go to our store
help.subscribe_p1: Visit Cuebids in a web browser, in the iOS app, or in the Android app.
help.subscribe_p2: Then go to the Store (heart icon on the start page) and select a tier of subscription.
help.tickets_p1: Tickets are used to play events, challenges or practice with advanced robots.
help.tickets_p2: Every month you get new tickets. Supporters get more tickets. Club subscribers get 96 tickets per month, Diamond subscribers get 240 tickets and Heart subscribers get infinite tickets. You can also purchase tickets separately.
help.tickets_p3: Check out the store for more details.
help.tickets_store_button: Click here to go to our store
help.events_p1: There are two running events at the moment:
help.events_p2: Join these events with your partner on the Events page. You can finish the event at any time, but you will not be considered for the leaderboard unless you finish on time.
help.events_p3: Try to get as many stars as possible to rank high on the leaderboard. The winners (possibly shared) will get a corresponding win in their profile.
help.events_p4: Groups can also host their own private events.
help.ranking_title: How does the ranking system work?
help.ranking_p1: Ranked challenges have a separate ranking system.
help.ranking_ul_li1: Each player has a hidden elo rating used for matchmaking (to make fair matches).
help.ranking_ul_li2: When you win a challenge you gain a star. When you lose a challenge you lose a star (not to be confused with the stars rewarded on each hand you play on Cuebids).
help.ranking_ul_li3: When you have 5 stars and win another match you advance to the next level (jack/queen/king/ace).
help.ranking_ul_li4: When you reach ace with five stars your elo rating is revealed. This is used to determine the top 10 ranking of players.
help.contact_link: Click here to go to our contact page
help.social_media_info: Cuebids can be found on various social media
help.release_notes_link: Click here to go to the release notes
